author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Rhode Island State Police arrested a 19-year-old North Kingstown man after troopers located a vehicle that had been the subject of a lookout alert tied to a reported firearm-brandishing incident, the agency said in its Friday arrest report.

Troopers stopped the vehicle on Frenchtown Road in East Greenwich and arrested Collin Dionne at 9:55 a.m. He was charged with felony assault by use of a device similar in appearance to a firearm and disorderly conduct. State Police said Dionne was taken to the Wickford Barracks for processing and then transported to Third Division District Court.

The daily arrest notice provides the charges and the sequence of the stop but does not describe the object involved, identify a complainant or disclose whether anyone was injured. The allegations have not been proven in court, and Dionne is presumed innocent unless convicted. The case now moves through the district-court process, where prosecutors must present evidence supporting the charges and the defense will have an opportunity to respond.
dek: Troopers said they stopped a lookout vehicle on Frenchtown Road after a reported firearm-brandishing incident.
headline: State Police arrest North Kingstown man after firearm lookout alert
